rival_writes.same_image: Exact signed original request replay; new witness sequence with identical canonical image and original response bytes
rival_writes.changed_image: Signed manager pause for gateway, or signed receiver checkpoint at a later clock; changes authoritative image while preserving tape/budget/first-fact evidence

recovery_rule.before_capture: Restore the new head's image and anchor
recovery_rule.change_visible_at_recheck: Reject and roll back both local image and anchor
recovery_rule.change_after_recheck: May commit the captured old image and matching anchor; returning this identity is not a currentness lease
recovery_rule.next_business: Reject a stale anchor before business-state observation
recovery_rule.advance_after_begin_guard: Expected-version CAS rejects the losing transaction; no successful response or local business commit

assertions: Rival uses separate database and witness connections and advances exactly one sequence
Same-image advance is distinguished from unchanged authority
Recovery does not call business dispatch or witness compare_and_store
Rejected recovery leaves image and optional anchor unchanged
Successful recovery installs an internally consistent snapshot even when already stale
Blocked business use leaves local state unchanged
CAS conflict rolls back tentative business changes and returns no success
After rival stops, exact recovery and database reopen preserve original tape, accounting rows or first-fact ciphertext
Original signed request replay returns identical response bytes and a new same-image witness attempt
negative_controls: compare only image digest, ignoring sequence
trusted_observations: Head identities and image digests are private diagnostic evidence, not public simulator inputs or emitted public events.
scope_limits: One scripted competing valid transaction per episode; deterministic interleavings, not a scheduling stress test
Local ReferenceWitness with linearizable nonrollback authority assumed; no TLS, cross-host or power-loss evidence
No composition with prior process exits, preparation or retention cleanup races
No liveness guarantee against a continuously advancing rival
No complete R1-R12 simulator extension, general induction, timing/length privacy or cryptographic/DP composition proof
